messages.subject: win xp scheduled task that deployApp fails when I am not logged on
parts:
I have noticed that a scheduled task that deploys an app always fail when i am not logged in. Do I have to turn on automatic logon in Windows XP or there is another solution?

Thank you

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] win xp scheduled task that deployApp fails when I am not logged on
parts:
Yes, I am referring to a Shinyapp. I am trying to automatically redeploy my shiny app, using a scheduled task that runs an Rscript.

When I say logged in, i mean logged in my windows account. I have configured my pc to start-up automatically (without logging in), when I am away, and run this task. I noticed that the task always ended with an error (result 0x1). Then I set my computer to automatically logon, using my account (using method 1 here http://support2.microsoft.com/kb/315231), and noticed that, from that moment on, the task was completed successfully (result 0x0). So I am asking if I really have to log on in order to deployApp, or there is something else that I am missing.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] win xp scheduled task that deployApp fails when I am not logged on
parts: deploying to shinyapps.io does not need you to be logged in, no.  It communicates with the server using the secret token that you use, so I am guessing something else is going on with your windows box when it starts up without being logged in.  Maybe the network stack is not up, or somehow not routing appropriately?
